# @quietbuildlab/ui

> Themed shadcn/ui component library. Six ready-made themes (Manuscript, Midnight, Slate, Sunset, Ocean, Mono) light + dark, 31 components on Radix UI + Tailwind v4. Pick a theme with one CSS import or switch at runtime via `data-theme`. Re-themable further via CSS variable overrides.

## Install

`npm install @quietbuildlab/ui` — requires Tailwind CSS v4 and React 18 or 19.

In the consumer app's main CSS, pick ONE setup:

```
/* A) single preset */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@quietbuildlab/ui/themes/midnight.css";    /* manuscript | midnight | slate | sunset | ocean | mono */
@source "../node_modules/@quietbuildlab/ui/dist";
```

```
/* B) backward-compat (Manuscript only) */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@quietbuildlab/ui/theme.css";
@source "../node_modules/@quietbuildlab/ui/dist";
```

```
/* C) runtime switching */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@quietbuildlab/ui/themes.css";
@source "../node_modules/@quietbuildlab/ui/dist";
```

For C, set `document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "ocean"` to change theme; default is Manuscript. Toggle a `.dark` class on `<html>` for dark mode in any mode.

## Themes

| Theme | Vibe | Accent | Radius | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manuscript | Warm paper, editorial | Forest green | 4px | Lora + Inter |
| Midnight | Cool, focused | Indigo | 6px | Inter |
| Slate | Neutral, corporate | Slate-blue | 4px | Inter |
| Sunset | Warm, friendly | Coral | 10px | Inter |
| Ocean | Calm SaaS | Teal | 6px | Inter |
| Mono | Brutalist B/W | Black/white | 0px | Inter + mono |

## Components

All exported as named imports from the package root (`import { Button } from '@quietbuildlab/ui'`).

- **Accordion** + **AccordionItem**, **AccordionTrigger**, **AccordionContent** — collapsible sections. `type="single" collapsible` or `type="multiple"`.
- **Alert** + **AlertTitle**, **AlertDescription** — inline non-blocking status banner. Variants: default | destructive.
- **AlertDialog** + **AlertDialogTrigger**, **AlertDialogContent**, **AlertDialogHeader**, **AlertDialogTitle**, **AlertDialogDescription**, **AlertDialogFooter**, **AlertDialogAction**, **AlertDialogCancel** — blocking yes/no confirmation modal. Use for destructive actions.
- **Avatar** + **AvatarImage**, **AvatarFallback** — user image with text fallback. Size via `className` (`size-6`, `size-10`, etc.).
- **Button** — variants: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link. Sizes: default, sm, lg, icon. Supports `asChild` (Radix Slot).
- **Badge** — variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline.
- **Input** — text input. Standard `<input>` props.
- **Textarea** — multi-line input.
- **Label** — `<label>` wrapper; pair with `htmlFor`.
- **Card** + **CardHeader**, **CardTitle**, **CardDescription**, **CardContent**, **CardFooter**, **CardAction** — surface container.
- **Dialog** + **DialogTrigger**, **DialogContent**, **DialogHeader**, **DialogTitle**, **DialogDescription**, **DialogFooter**, **DialogClose** — modal. Portals to document.body.
- **DropdownMenu** + **Trigger**, **Content**, **Item**, **Separator**, **Label** — menu. Portals.
- **Popover** + **Trigger**, **Content**, **Anchor** — anchored non-modal overlay. Portals.
- **Sheet** + **SheetTrigger**, **SheetContent**, **SheetHeader**, **SheetTitle**, **SheetDescription**, **SheetFooter**, **SheetClose** — slide-in panel. `side` prop: top | right (default) | bottom | left.
- **Slider** — range input. `defaultValue={[50]}` for single, `defaultValue={[20, 80]}` for range.
- **Tooltip** + **Trigger**, **Content**, **Provider** — needs an ancestor `<TooltipProvider>`.
- **Select** + **Trigger**, **Value**, **Content**, **Item**, **Group**, **Label** — combobox. Portals.
- **Checkbox**, **Switch**, **RadioGroup** + **RadioGroupItem** — controlled or uncontrolled.
- **Tabs** + **TabsList**, **TabsTrigger**, **TabsContent**.
- **Separator** — orientation: horizontal (default) | vertical.
- **Skeleton** — loading placeholder; size via `className`.
- **Progress** — `value` 0–100.
- **Toaster** — mount once at app root; trigger toasts via `import { toast } from 'sonner'`. Note: uses `next-themes` for color-mode detection — without a `<ThemeProvider>` it falls back to OS `prefers-color-scheme`.
- **Table** + **TableHeader**, **TableBody**, **TableFooter**, **TableHead**, **TableRow**, **TableCell**, **TableCaption** — primitive. Style only.
- **Pagination** + **Content**, **Item**, **Link**, **Previous**, **Next**, **Ellipsis** — UI primitive for numbered pagination.
- **DataTable** — TanStack-powered. Client-side (default) and server-side (presence of `pageCount`) pagination. Built-in rows-per-page selector + `loading` prop.
- **FilePicker** + **FilePickerDropzone**, **FilePickerTrigger**, **FilePickerInput**, **FilePickerList**, **FilePickerItem**, **FilePickerClear** — compound file picker with click + drag-and-drop, controlled/uncontrolled, per-file preview/size/remove, `accept`/`maxSize`/`maxFiles` validation via `onError(reason, file?)`. Default layout renders dropzone + trigger + list if no children passed; pass children for full compound control. Also exports `formatBytes` helper and `FilePickerErrorReason` type.
- **Calendar** — themed `react-day-picker` v10. Modes: `single` | `range` | `multiple`. Forwards all `DayPickerProps` including `numberOfMonths`, `disabled` matchers, `defaultMonth`. Use directly for inline calendars; wrap in `<Popover>` for custom date-range pickers.
- **DatePicker** + **DatePickerTrigger**, **DatePickerContent** — single-date popover picker built on `Popover` + `Calendar`. Controlled (`value`/`onValueChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`). `minDate`/`maxDate` bounds, `locale` (Intl.DateTimeFormat default), custom `format` fn.

## Theming

Override CSS variables AFTER the preset import — every component picks up the cascade:

```css
:root {
  --primary: oklch(0.40 0.10 250);
  --ring: oklch(0.40 0.10 250);
  --radius: 0.5rem;
}
.dark {
  --primary: oklch(0.65 0.10 250);
  --ring: oklch(0.65 0.10 250);
}
```

Token groups: surfaces (`background`, `foreground`, `card`, `popover`), accent (`primary`, `ring`), quiet UI (`secondary`, `muted`, `accent`), form (`border`, `input`), status (`destructive`), shape (`radius`), type (`font-sans`, `font-serif`), plus `chart-1..5` and `sidebar-*`.
